arguments.message: Renaming a workspace only changes its display name – it doesn’t touch the workspace’s URL, API base path, or any identifiers that integrations or webhooks use. In short, your existing integrations will keep working after a rename. The only place the old name might still show up is in any email addresses or subdomains you set up separately; those are configured independently and won’t update automatically. So you can safely rename without worrying about breaking connected services.
